svg.title: Backwater Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 134-135, PDF 135-136. Combined aligned decks retain narrow flat nose, tapered accommodation body, stepped aft fuel shoulders and protruding side drive ends. Matching grid and beam support lower/upper alignment; larger lower drive ends extend beyond upper stern. Illustration corroborates compact tapered freighter with broad aft machinery. Interiors excluded.
